reply.emotion: mouth-watering and eager, anticipating a delicious treat
notes: In Mexico and many other Spanish-speaking countries, 'chocolate' can refer both to the solid candy bar and to a warm, comforting hot chocolate drink made with milk or water.

senses.definition: Alimento dulce hecho con cacao y azúcar, que suele comerse en tabletas.

examples.text: Me gusta comer un poco de chocolate después de cenar.
examples.translation: I like to eat a little bit of chocolate after dinner.
examples.emotion: relaxed and content, looking forward to a sweet bite

senses.definition: Bebida caliente o fría que se prepara disolviendo cacao o chocolate en leche o agua.

examples.text: En las mañanas frías me preparo un chocolate caliente.
examples.translation: On cold mornings I make myself a hot chocolate.
examples.emotion: cozy and warm, wrapping hands around a steaming mug
